rank_controls: Original three development shapes;128distinct evaluated score inputs,40randomized identical-library pairs per shape. No heldout/confirmation inputs.
validation_controls: 10paired0/5ms injected host delays on notes;20randomized armed/unarmed observer pairs;20complete application16-sequence identical-library pairs using changed inputs each round.
raw_records: All observed owned-process commits retained with tag/sequence/hostcommit/GPUstart/end/status. Callback-count equality, no dropped/duplicate records, pending drained, successful uninstall.
metrics: Instrumented host wall; current-thread CPU; union/sum/extent of positive completed command-buffer GPU intervals. Zero timestamps explicit: do not infer complete GPU coverage if present. Includes observer overhead; command-buffer time is not pure kernel execution or device exclusivity.
decision: Library-only mechanism validity/noise evidence only. Never reinterpret V2, count device-only timing as application benefit, discard unfavorable pairs, or execute/rank/select custom candidates. A future study needs a justified prospective design; no automatic V3.
